message.text: [Line art](http://127.0.0.1:59352/imagine/lines/) passed the independent review after seven fixes, including a result-first mobile view and reloadable settings. The safe merge is running; [review and proof](/framework/ai/2026-10-01/line-filter/) are preserved again after the unrelated file-deletion incident.

[Open Line art](http://monorepo.localhost/imagine/lines/) — merged and checked on the live site. Upload or drop an image, try four samples, tune four sliders, and save PNG; mobile shows the result first. [Proof checklist and review](http://monorepo.localhost/framework/ai/2026-10-01/line-filter/): seven findings fixed. Corners, SVG and 3D remain later.

Owner-check found 11 item(s) the owner asked for that aren't done: #5 rough shapes (8-corner boxes), LLM-assisted region/object identification; #6 parts of an object (e.g. a table) stay logically linked; #9 logical analysis to help reconstruct the 3D scene; #11 a solver that wiggles numbers to fit a 3D model; #12 placing the camera in the scene is important; #13 extrapolate a wall's corners from its visible edges; #18 determine real-world scale (closer = bigger, further = smaller); #19 need 3D point positions and a unit system; #28 color text in solid black rather than just outlining it; #40 theorize later about turning this into 3D space; #41 rough heights/widths/coordinates, an anchor point per 3D object (not a priority yet). See public/framework/ai/2026-10-01/line-filter/owner-check.md.
